task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence with two bounded candidate changes: make the ordinary title-to-result/retry route and authored cemetery spatial contract genuinely traversable and inspectable, and make upgrade choices an authored, accessible visual hierarchy while preserving truthful dense-profile rejection/receipts for native-host recapture.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release candidate has an authoritative five-wave/result path and dense-profile hooks, but the normal player route has only been proven with a diagnostic victory fixture, while dense qualification is rejected on llvmpipe with zero native samples. The remaining product-facing risk is spatial/run integrity plus a choice surface that must be verified as a real visual decision interface; native performance qualification itself requires a later eligible-renderer recapture.

stop_conditions: Do not claim the dense-performance gap closed on Mesa llvmpipe or with zero native frame samples; retain an explicit rejected_software_renderer status until an eligible native renderer supplies three complete retries.
Do not use tester_* fixtures, synthetic route rows, or diagnostic victory preparation as ordinary-route evidence.
Keep the retained authored cemetery package intact; additive outer-world geometry, collision, navigation, spawn, and objective bindings may be repaired, but do not replace or split the package.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause approach from prior evidence-only/transform-tuning attempts: repair the authoritative wave/lifecycle and world binding so ordinary input can complete the real route, then replace prose-stacked upgrade presentation with a data-bound visual hierarchy and focus model. Treat dense profiling as guarded instrumentation that enables host recapture without falsely qualifying software-renderer measurements.

code: Run focused Godot parse/import checks on the listed scene and script owners; inspect that wave transitions, Result/Retry reset, spatial bindings, upgrade eligibility/current-to-new values, focus handlers, and dense receipt fields remain authoritative and release-guarded.
Verify the ordinary route contains no diagnostic fixture invocation and that dense instrumentation cannot mark llvmpipe/software-renderer samples as qualified.
runtime: Tester performs a fresh ordinary title-to-Result-to-Retry replay using only keyboard/gamepad/mouse ordinary input and captures guidance, pickup, draft, all five wave ids, elite/Bellkeeper, Result statistics, and clean Retry state.

Tester replays ordinary movement around every side of the central landmark and along the boundary/perimeter, recording collision, visibility/occlusion, external-depth, spawn-safety, playable extents, and time-to-cross receipts.

On an eligible native renderer, Tester runs dense prepare/advance/reset across three retries at 1920x1080 and representative 25-40 enemy density, binding renderer, frame-time distributions, lifecycle, and cleanup; on llvmpipe, record rejected_software_renderer and leave the gap open.
visual: Inspect native and PRD-reference screenshots of the cemetery at center, four cardinal perimeter views, landmark approach/near-contact/departure, and ordinary movement replay for larger traversable scale, external world/depth, stable collision-aligned geometry, and no disappearance/empty void.

Inspect upgrade-draft screenshots at native and reference resolution for silhouette/icon anchors, visual hierarchy, compact current-to-new values with no more than three deltas, readable spacing, and distinct keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus, hover, unavailable, unlocked, and selected states.

done_when: A fresh title Play run teaches movement, dash, automatic attack, pickup collection, and the first upgrade in the real arena through concise dismissible guidance; dismissal does not consume combat input, leave pause ownership stale, or reappear on Retry.

Ordinary input alone advances the authored wave ids first_toll, crossing_shadows, gravewind, long_procession, and bellkeeper with no tester_* action, includes the elite and Bellkeeper terminal state, reaches Result with time/level/defeated/damage/upgrade/victory-or-failure data, and Retry starts a clean run with no stale actors, audio, pause, or UI state.

The world repair records a real expand or larger traversable scale change with before/after playable extents and time-to-cross, plus a coherent external world or external depth beyond the gameplay boundary at multiple cardinal views.

The central building or landmark has visible-footprint-aligned collision and navigation/spawn exclusion; ordinary movement replay around every side verifies collision, no pass-through, no disappearance or whole-landmark occlusion, and stable visibility before approach, near contact, and after departure.

Boundary or perimeter traversal remains inside the authored walkable space while the shipped camera retains escape lanes and does not reveal an empty void; representative enemies also respect the same collision and spawn boundary.
tasks.instructions: Own the ordinary run/lifecycle and cemetery spatial surfaces. Inspect the real RunController/WaveDirector, first-run guidance, authored CemeteryGarden instance, and cemetery spatial contract. Repair progression so ordinary movement, automatic combat, pickups, upgrade pause/resume, five waves, Bellkeeper, Result, and Retry are reachable without diagnostic fixtures. Rebind spawn, objective, navigation, and collision to the intact authored streets and landmarks; add only the necessary outer datum and non-playable external world/depth. Explicitly implement and verify expand or larger traversable scale, external world or external depth, central building or landmark collision, disappearance or occlusion handling, boundary or perimeter behavior, and ordinary movement or movement replay evidence. Keep camera framing high-angle and readable rather than solving scale with a permanent whole-map zoom.

done_when: Each upgrade/weapon choice leads with a recognizable silhouette or authored icon and a clear visual hierarchy; compact stat icons show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, omitting unchanged, zero-placeholder, locked, and unrelated rows.

The upgrade draft is not a text-stacked/debug form: name, rank/eligibility, one consequence line, and action affordance are subordinate to the icon/silhouette anchor, with no clipping or overlap at the configured native and PRD reference viewports.

Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states are all distinct for focus, hover, unavailable, newly unlocked, and selected states without changing card dimensions; held confirm is debounced and the authoritative selected id/rank/modifier is applied before gameplay resumes.

Dense-profile preparation/advance/reset emits renderer qualification, profile sample count, frame-time distribution, lifecycle, and cleanup receipts for three retries at 1920x1080 representative density, while explicitly rejecting llvmpipe/software-renderer samples instead of reporting a false pass.
